Maya: Quick async: I'm running the small 'installfest' for the sampleflow packaging today.
Maya: What I did: fixed the README steps for macOS ARM wheels, added a note about choosing x86 vs arm venv.
Maya: Blockers: CI on macOS runner flakes on wheel build, still investigating error `wheel not found for torch-llm`.
Maya: Today: try a rebuild with an older pip, and open a tiny PR to pin the wheel step.

Jon: Thanks — I hit the same flake locally yesterday. Saw `pip` 23.3 behaves differently on arm.
Jon: I can try a manual build on an m1 instance later and report back.

Tarek: Heads-up: sampleapp quickstart had an import path change in the SDK pr that landed last night.
Tarek: If you see `ModuleNotFoundError: samplekit.quickstart`, use `samplekit.quickstart_v2` for now (we'll alias in next patch).

Sam: Small ask — can someone bump the quickstart snippet in docs? The snippet in getting_started.md still uses the old import.
Sam: PR queued: #4527 (docs) — pinging @Maya for the packaging note.

Priya: For the CI flake, I added a retry step to the macos job in a local branch. It helped once. Might be flaky network to wheels host.
Priya: Also, I pushed a doc snippet for `pip` workaround:
Priya: ```bash
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip==23.0.1
pip wheel . -w dist/
```

Maya: Nice, Priya — will try that exact sequence. If it works I'll update the quickstart and add a small note under Troubleshooting.

Jon: FYI, I ran `python -m sampleapp.run --quickstart` on my intel mac and it was fine. The failing path only triggers on arm wheel resolution.

docs-bot: CI passed for docs PR #4521 (getting_started reflow).

docs-bot: Note: There is an unresolved doc lint warning in staging branch (line-length in sample snippet).

Maya: Action items:
- Maya: try pip downgrade + rebuild (this morning)
- Priya: open a tiny CI retry PR for macos job (if you can)
- Jon: test on m1 instance and paste logs in this thread
- Sam: rebase #4527 after Maya updates the snippet

Maya: If anyone hits more import breakage, drop a quick paste of the stack trace here. Trying to keep the installfest light — thanks all :celebrate:
